args.title: Document the limits on report fields in the API reference
args.body:
File: docs/api-reference.md

Add documentation of the limits on report fields that are enforced by the API but currently undocumented. Specifically, list the maximum number of recipients for a scheduled export (20), the maximum length of a report name (120 characters), and the maximum number of categories (50). This ensures that clients can validate data before sending requests, avoiding validation errors.
